title: 推文计数
summary: 记录推文在某秒发布，并按 minute、hour、day 的桶宽查询闭区间内每个时间桶的发布次数。
insight: 为每个名称维护时间到次数的有序映射；查询时创建固定数量桶，只遍历起止区间内记录，并按 (time-start)/bucketSize 累加。
pitfalls: 相同名称同一时刻可记录多次
查询 endTime 包含在内
最后一个桶可能短于标准桶宽

solutions.title: 有序时间频次分桶
solutions.idea: 用有序子区间只扫描相关记录。
steps: recordTweet 在 name 对应 TreeMap 中 merge(time,1)
查询把频率映射为 60、3600、86400，创建 (end-start)/width+1 个零
遍历 subMap(start,true,end,true)，把 count 加到 (time-start)/width 桶，返回列表

complexity.time: 记录 O(log n)，查询 O(log n+区间记录数)

code.java: class TweetCounts { private final Map<String,TreeMap<Integer,Integer>> records=new HashMap<>();public void recordTweet(String tweetName,int time){records.computeIfAbsent(tweetName,key->new TreeMap<>()).merge(time,1,Integer::sum);}public List<Integer> getTweetCountsPerFrequency(String freq,String tweetName,int startTime,int endTime){int width=freq.equals("minute")?60:freq.equals("hour")?3600:86400;List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies((endTime-startTime)/width+1,0));TreeMap<Integer,Integer> times=records.getOrDefault(tweetName,new TreeMap<>());for(Map.Entry<Integer,Integer> entry:times.subMap(startTime,true,endTime,true).entrySet()){int index=(entry.getKey()-startTime)/width;answer.set(index,answer.get(index)+entry.getValue());}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class TweetCounts { private val records=mutableMapOf<String,java.util.TreeMap<Int,Int>>();fun recordTweet(tweetName:String,time:Int){val times=records.getOrPut(tweetName){java.util.TreeMap()};times[time]=(times[time]?:0)+1};fun getTweetCountsPerFrequency(freq:String,tweetName:String,startTime:Int,endTime:Int):List<Int>{val width=if(freq=="minute")60 else if(freq=="hour")3600 else 86400;val answer=MutableList((endTime-startTime)/width+1){0};val times=records[tweetName]?:java.util.TreeMap();for((time,count) in times.subMap(startTime,true,endTime,true)){val index=(time-startTime)/width;answer[index]+=count};return answer} }
code.cpp: class TweetCounts { unordered_map<string,map<int,int>> records;public:void recordTweet(string tweetName,int time){++records[tweetName][time];}vector<int> getTweetCountsPerFrequency(string freq,string tweetName,int startTime,int endTime){int width=freq=="minute"?60:freq=="hour"?3600:86400;vector<int> answer((endTime-startTime)/width+1);auto& times=records[tweetName];for(auto it=times.lower_bound(startTime);it!=times.end()&&it->first<=endTime;++it)answer[(it->first-startTime)/width]+=it->second;return answer;} };
